items.title: Short-Term Bond Funds vs. Dividend Stocks: Which Income Holds Up Better for Retirees?

items.title: 'Exxon Got Walloped': $340 Million Legal Blow Paves The Way For More
items.summary: A district judge recently dealt ExxonMobil (XOM) a $339.56 million blow over oil sludge that's "continuously seeped" into soil, surface water, and an aquifer in northwest Louisiana for half a century. Legal experts say the first-of-its-kind judgment paves the way for future citizen lawsuits against oil giants in the state, which has long rated among the most polluted in the...
